name: hasu-gallery
description: 双画廊 UGC 平台 (Meme + Art) - pnpm monorepo

scripts.sync:web-embed: node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('child_process'); const isWin=process.platform==='win32'; const cmd=isWin?'pwsh':'bash'; const script=isWin?'scripts/sync-web-embed.ps1':'scripts/sync-web-embed.sh'; const args=isWin?['-File',script]:[script]; const r=spawnSync(cmd,args,{stdio:'inherit'}); process.exit(r.status??1);"
scripts.build:galleryd: pnpm --filter @hasu-gallery/web build && pnpm run sync:web-embed && cargo build --release --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml --bin galleryd
